text: 燧原科技公告，公司股票将于2026年9月11日在上海证券交易所科创板上市，发行价格142.18元/股。公司预计2026年1-9月营业收入23亿至30亿元，同比增长325.78%至455.36%。
text_en: Suiyuan Technology announced its shares will list on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market on September 11, 2026, at an issue price of 142.18 yuan per share. The company projects revenue of 2.3 billion to 3 billion yuan for January-September 2026, up 325.78% to 455.36% year-on-year.
